Charles Bloom, Planning & Development Department Director, provided a staff report and noted
that a representative from the Historic Preservation Board was to be in attendance to answer
questions related to the contents of the proposed ordinance. Chairman Cook and committee
members Laybourn, Rinne and Segrave commented on the item. Public comment was made by
Councilmember Richard Johnson, Ward III, and Michael White.

16. | RESOLUTION ~ Expressing the support of the Governing Body to request the State of
Wyoming to reconsider the decriminalization of cannabis and reform to the Wyoming
Controlled Substance Act. (SPONSOR ~ MR. JOHNSON)

Dr. Rinne moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion failed by unanimous voice vote.

Councilmember Richard Johnson, Ward II, and sponsor of the item provided an overview of the
proposed resolution. Committee members Laybourn and Segrave commented on the item and
public comment was made by Daniel Singh, Wyoming State Representative House District 61.

Following the vote on item #16, Dr. Rinne’s intemet connection was unstable causing him to drop
in and out of the meeting for the remainder of the meeting.

17. RESOLUTION - Declaring that the City of Cheyenne has agreed that covenants
restricting application of Waterwise Landscaping or requiring installation of Water-
Intense Landscaping mandate irresponsible use of water resources and requesting the
State Legislative Committees and State Legislature review, consider, and adopt
modifications to State Statutes to nullify covenants that restrict Waterwise Landscaping or
require installation of Water-Intense Landscaping. (SPONSOR — MR. JOHNSON)

Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion failed with Chairman Cook and Mr.
Segrave voting “NO” and Mr. Laybourn voting “YES”. (NOTE: A vote from Dr. Rinne was not
recorded due to poor connectivity.)

Charles Bloom, Planning & Development Department Director, provided a staff report.
Committee members Laybourn and Segrave commented on the item and public comment was
made by Sarah Bargsten, Board of Public Utilities Water Conservation Specialist, Robin Sims and
Michael White.

18. RESOLUTION — Directing City staff to research and provide a report regarding the
property currently utilized as a detention pond at Highland Village Subdivision.
(SPONSORS — MR. LAYBOURN AND MR. WHITE)

Mr. Laybourn moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Mr. Segrave moved to amend by
substitute dated August 1, 2023, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion to amend carried by
unanimous voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.
